content:
kevin_m: Heads-up: vendor just gave partial ETA for H100s — split pallets across FRA/AMS. Need a plan for customs hold and temporary pool. @nina_supplier can you confirm timelines and whether they can consolidate AWBs?

nina_supplier: We can split into 2 pallets: PAL-A (FRA) ETA 2025-07-27, PAL-B (AMS) ETA 2025-07-29. Can consolidate to single AWB but courier charges apply. Propose consolidate only if you accept extra brokerage ~$450/pallet.

alana_ops: What about serial lists? We'll need manifest for warehouse intake + temp pool tags. Can vendor provide CSV of serial->AWB + suggested node-tags?

nina_supplier: Yes. Sending manifest now. attaching.

logistics-bot: nina_supplier uploaded manifest_1747654321.csv (1.1MB)

kevin_m: Quick Q: Any chance of rerouting FRA to our EU-temp-pool to avoid AMS customs backlog? Region constraint: AMS port has ~3-day processing delays.

nina_supplier: FRA clears faster but carrier ramp limited. If we reroute, additional transit +$1200 and 2x handling. We can mark 'temporary loaner' on customs docs to speed release, needs invoice amendment.

rohit_infra: Operational constraints: we'll need serial mapping into inventory before provisioning; temp pool can hold up to 20 units. If both pallets arrive that's 36 units — need immediate staging plan. Could we accept only PAL-A now and backfill PAL-B later?

alana_ops: We can accept PAL-A and receive it to temp pool; request vendor hold PAL-B for 5 days. Will you accept storage fee?

nina_supplier: We can hold PAL-B free for 5 days, after that storage $200/day/pallet. For RMA: if any DOA within 7 days, vendor can swap at our depot — swaps require AWB consolidation and return labels.

kevin_m: Understood. We'll accept PAL-A -> temp pool ingestion; hold PAL-B for 5 days. Please send revised proforma with AWB split and storage terms. Also need per-unit warranty start date adjusted to actual handover.

nina_supplier: Sending updated proforma in ~30m. Note: if customs reclassification triggers duties, we'll reconcile later. Suggest pre-declare HS-code 8471.80. (cc @alana_ops)

rohit_infra: One more ask: for provisioning, can vendor pre-map serials to node tags in CSV with fields: serial, model, suggested-node-tag. Example:
```
H100-ABC123,h100,h100-eu-001
H100-DEF456,h100,h100-eu-002
```
That'll speed cluster bring-up.

nina_supplier: Yes. Manifest will include those fields.

alana_ops: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate receiving and create temp-pool tickets. Kevin, I'll add a canary runway in cluster for first 8 units before scaling.

kevin_m: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll wait for proforma and manifest. tagging vendor process: @nina_supplier pls confirm by EOD.
